**Job Description: Software Product Management (SPM)**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking a Software Product Manager - SME App with extensive background in designing and delivering enterprise and/or internet-scale tools within the financial services space. This candidate must possess a blend of technical proficiency and market insight, with at least 5-9 years of professional experience in software product management. Experience can be in either customer-facing or employee-facing domains (or both).

**Domain expertise:** on top of foundational software product management experience, the ideal candidate will have extensive domain expertise in building digital app/solutions for SMEs and business customers. Prior experience in products such as Working Capital, Overdraft Accounts and Merchant solutions, etc. will be preferred.

Your role will be crucial in devising innovative solutions that address the intricate demands of the dynamic financial services landscape while significantly improving the day-to-day operations for employees.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Strategic Planning:** Develop a comprehensive product strategy that encompasses market needs, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements. Define the vision and roadmap for enterprise and employee-facing tools.
* **Market Analysis:** Perform in-depth market research and analysis to understand the competitive landscape, banking & fintech industry trends, and customer needs. Identify gaps and opportunities for innovation.
* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Manage the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and development to launch, evaluation, and iteration. Ensure the product aligns with the business goals and delivers value to end-users.
* **Feature Development:** Work closely with stakeholders to define and prioritize features. Create detailed requirements and user stories that align with the overall product strategy.
* **Cross-functional Leadership:** Lead cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, QA, and business units, to deliver high-quality products on time and within budget. Facilitate communication and collaboration among teams.
* **Performance Metrics:** Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success and inform future development decisions. Regularly report on product performance and strategic adjustments.
* **User Experience:** Champion a superior user experience, ensuring the tools are intuitive, efficient, and tailored to the unique needs of banking & fintech employees.
* **Compliance & Security:** Ensure all products meet the stringent regulatory, compliance, and security requirements specific to the banking industry.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Maintain regular communication with all stakeholders, including senior management, end-users, and IT teams. Gather and incorporate feedback to continuously improve the product.
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
* At least 5-9 years of professional experience in software product management, with a focus on enterprise and/or internet-scale tools.
* Demonstrated success in developing and launching impactful software products.
* Proficient in Agile methodologies and tools.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong leadership capabilities and experience managing cross-functional teams.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Technical background with an understanding of software development practices and web technologies.
* Prior experience with digital transformation initiatives in broking or financial services.
* Have worked on building digital products & app experiences for SME/business customers.
* Prior experience in products such as Working Capital, Overdraft Accounts and Merchant solutions, etc.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements (e.g., RBI).

* Payment and Account Administration: Utilize Stripe platform to resolve customer access issues, update user email addresses and payment methods, and address general customer concerns
* Issue Analysis and Reporting: Create reports documenting common customer support issues in Google Docs/Sheets format to enable product teams to prioritize system improvements and enhance customer experience

title: Manager - Credit Implementation
description:

Our vision is to build the best-in-class infrastructure for lending products and help Banks & Financial Services companies across the world scale and launch credit programs that set a new standard in the era of digital finance. So far, we’ve helped our customers disburse Billions of Dollars in credit across unsecured and secured credit including personal loans, working capital loans, business loans, mortgage and education loans. FinBox solutions are already being used by over 100+ companies to deliver credit to over 5 million customers every month.

* **Innovative Environment:** At FinBox, we foster a culture of creativity and experimentation, encouraging our team to push the boundaries of what's possible in fintech.

At FinBox, we’re on the lookout for exceptional folks who are all about innovation and impact. If you’re excited to shake things up in the banking & financial services world, keep reading!

**Creative Thinkers:** If your brain is always bubbling with out-of-the-box ideas and wild solutions, you’re our kind of person. We love disruptors who challenge the norm and bring fresh perspectives to the table.

**Customer Heroes:** Our customers are our champions, and we need heroes who can understand their needs, deliver magical experiences, and go above and beyond to keep them happy.

* Own end-to-end implementation of credit and lending products for new FinBox clients
* Collaborate with client credit/risk teams to define underwriting criteria, rule sets, and approval logic
* Translate credit policies into technical configurations within FinBox’s decisioning tools and APIs
* Coordinate cross-functionally with internal product, engineering, and customer success teams

description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.

Job Description \- Curated Experience (Executive)

The Curated Experience Executive shall work closely in co\-ordination with the Curated Experience Sr. Executive ensuring visibility and presence on a day\-to\-day requirement \& ensure organization associates and visitors are welcomed, valued, and taken care of at every stage while they are in the office.

Guest Experience
  
The Executive is the first face a colleague sees and the last impression a guest carries with them. This means expressing warmth and professionalism at reception or entry, greeting people with care, and creating an atmosphere where every individual feels that their presence matters. Beyond the greeting, the Executive takes ownership of the physical readiness of the workplace by conducting regular and thorough checks of meeting rooms, collaboration spaces, pantries, and common areas to ensure everything is clean, stocked, and ready for use before it is needed. Responding to ad\-hoc colleague requests is done promptly and with a helpful spirit, and feedback collected during daily interactions is documented accurately and shared with the Sr. Executive to drive meaningful resolutions.
  
  

Operational Support
  
The Executive plays an active role in keeping daily operations flowing smoothly. Service requests are logged, tracked, and followed through to full resolution, with timely status updates provided to colleagues along the way. Daily site inspections are conducted with a watchful eye, identifying maintenance issues, supply gaps, or safety concerns before they escalate. Routine matters are channeled to the Curated Experience Sr. Executive, while safety or security concerns are escalated directly and immediately to the Facility Manager / Security Team. Trackers, logs, and basic operational reports are maintained with accuracy and consistency.
  
  

Conference \& Event Support
  
Executive ensures every room is set up to the highest standard viz., equipment tested, AV confirmed, refreshments in place (where requested), and the space reset promptly after every meeting concludes. For workplace events, training sessions, and engagement activities, the Executive provides dedicated on\-ground support, working alongside the Sr. Executive to deliver a seamless experience for every attendee.
  
  

Colleague Engagement \& Onboarding
  
Executive shall play a central role in making new hires feel genuinely at home from day one. Leading the site orientation tours, introducing colleagues to amenities, explaining workplace policies, and setting a warm and welcoming tone are all core to this responsibility. All colleague enquiries, whether received in person, via email or through chat are acknowledged and responded to within one business day. Executive also takes an active approach to learning by shadowing the Curated Experience Sr. Executive across site functions, building both capability and confidence within the Workplace Services environment.
  
  

Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
  
Executive shall gather real\-time experience feedback from colleagues and stakeholders during daily interactions, tours, and events, and document it accurately using designated trackers. This feedback need to be shared promptly with the Sr. Executive for review and closure, and the Executive follows up on minor items to confirm resolution. Beyond reactive feedback, Executive proactively reviews the service patterns, whether supply shortages, AV readiness issues, or space concerns contributing meaningfully to a culture of continuous improvement that elevates the experience for everyone.
  
  

Transport \& Commute Support
  
Executive serves as a trusted first point of contact for routine transport and commute queries, helping colleagues (especially new hires) navigate shuttle schedules, parking allocations, and booking protocols with confidence and ease. Complex issues, complaints, or service disruptions are escalated promptly to the Sr. Executive or the Transport team, ensuring no colleague is left without a resolution.

Workplace policies including clean desk standards, appropriate use of shared spaces, and visitor management are reinforced in a friendly, hospitality first manner that reflects the values of the Curated Experience team. Contractors and vendors on site are supported with basic orientation and access to amenities, ensuring their presence is well\-integrated and non\-disruptive. A Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification is preferred with Two to three years of experience in hospitality, customer service, front desk management, facilities coordination, or a closely related field. Candidates who bring a passion for people are strongly encouraged to apply, even if their background spans multiple industries.

The ideal candidate is warm, approachable, and genuinely service\-oriented, someone who takes pride in the details and finds satisfaction in making others feel cared for. Strong verbal and written communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, and composure to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment are essential. Cultural sensitivity, patience under pressure, and the ability to de\-escalate situations with grace are highly valued. A collaborative spirit, a strong willingness to learn and grow, and proficiency in the Microsoft Office including Teams, Outlook, Excel, and Word.
  
  

Working Hours
  
Flexibility to support early morning or late evening / night activities is required based on site needs, including shift\-based working arrangements where applicable.
  
  

Reporting Structure
  
The Curated Experience Executive reports directly to the Curated Experience Sr. Executive and works in close day\-to\-day collaboration with Facility Management teams across the site.
